en: A black-and-white postcard view of a harbor with a sailing ship docked alongside the waterfront. In the foreground there is a terraced area with railings and steps, possibly part of a quay or warehouse structure. Across the water, small buildings and houses line the shoreline. Printed text in the upper-left corner reads "Luleå, Norra Hamnen." The overall look is early 20th century.
